---
title: "Brain Data"
author: "Stanley Chhatwal"
---

I am going to calculate the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain; cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus.
```{r}
z <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
y <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
x <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("The sum of human genes with elevated expression in the forebrain is",z,"."))
print(paste("The sum of pig genes with elevated expression in the forebrain is",y,"."))
print(paste("The sum of mouse genes with elevated expression in the forebrain is" ,x, "."))
```
The species with the most amount of genes with elevated expression in the forebrain was humans.
